deadline.value: Fall 2027 applications must be complete by January 15, 2027.
deadline.quote: Applications for fall admission must be completed by January 15, 2027.

fee_waiver.value: Applicants with a complete GoGrad file before December 1, 2026 may be eligible for a fee waiver once an advisor commits.
fee_waiver.quote: Students who have a completed application on file on GoGrad prior to December 1, 2026 may be eligible to receive an application fee waiver.

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional and not required for admission.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is optional and not required for admission.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: The department also sets a TOEFL minimum of 4.5 for PhD research doctorates.
toefl_min.quote: PhD Research Doctorate Programs: A minimum score of 4.5 is required.

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact faculty whose research interests match theirs.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact individual faculty in the department who share research interests.

funding.value: Admission generally includes five years of financial support for PhD students.
funding.quote: Generally, admission to the program includes 5 years of financial support for PhD students

entry_route.value: PhD applicants need a bachelor's or master's in geosciences or a related field.
entry_route.quote: All students accepted into the doctoral program must have received a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in geosciences or a related field prior to enrolling

notes: The geosciences page repeats 'January 15, 2025' in its full-consideration sentence; the January 15, 2027 date is used.
